title: Ostomy Supply Program Customer-Requested Expedited Shipping Charges
content:
**Patient charges - Ostomy Supply Program.** A refill the customer asks to have sent expedited (two-day) carries an expedited shipping charge, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed.

## Scope

For the expedited shipping charge this policy handles - the charge for a refill a program shipped expedited at the customer's own request - and only for such a charge, the amount is set as this policy states; every other expedite is provided on the customer's request for the tier's expedited shipping fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed.

## When the charge is owed

The charge is owed once the program's most recent refill shipped with the shipping method expedited carries no expedited shipping charge; one charge is posted against that refill, and a program with no such refill owes no charge under this policy.

| Program's records (general cases) | Charge under this policy |
|---|---|
| Most recent refill shipped expedited carries no expedited shipping charge | Owed - one charge against that refill |
| That refill already carries an expedited shipping charge | None |
| No refill shipped expedited | None |

The refill is identified by the shipping method recorded on its shipment record: expedited.

## Effect once posted

The charge is added to the customer's balance on the enrollment and appears on the enrollment's billing history as a patient charge of the expedited shipping type linked to the shipment; the enrollment's balance due rises by the amount posted, and the posting date is the day it is posted.

## Posting the charge: `post_expedite_charge_9c5d9761`

`post_expedite_charge_9c5d9761` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). It posts an expedited shipping charge on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment for one refill shipment the customer asked to have sent expedited.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the charge is posted on, read from the enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `ostomy_shipment_id` | The expedited refill shipment record the charge relates to, read from the shipment history lookup of that enrollment | Identifier |
| `item_code` | The HCPCS code of the item on the expedited shipment | One of the values below |
| `amount` | The charge in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent by the caller; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

Values of `item_code`:

| Value | Item |
|---|---|
| `A4414` | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller |
| `A4407` | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity |
| `A4409` | Extended-wear flat skin barrier |
| `A4416` | One-piece closed pouch with filter |
| `A4423` | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier |
| `A4424` | One-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4427` | Two-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4431` | One-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4434` | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4406` | Pectin-based paste, per ounce |
| `A4455` | Adhesive remover, per ounce |
| `A4367` | Ostomy belt |
| `A4357` | Bedside drainage bag |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("posted" when the charge was recorded), `ostomy_ledger_id` (the new billing record), `ostomy_program_id`, `ostomy_shipment_id`, `item_code` (the HCPCS code of the item on the shipment), `charge_type` (always `expedited_shipping`), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `posting_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance_due` (the enrollment's balance due in USD after the charge, 2 decimal places). No other return is defined.
